name: 胆小鳗鱼
evolution: 胆小鳗鱼 → 闪电鳗鱼 Lv.36
description: 以强力放电而闻名的精灵，种族中的鳗鱼们似乎对自己的知名度一无所知。常常畏首畏尾，即使是十分弱小的对手，也能令它们战战兢兢。曾有胆小鳗鱼假死晕倒在浅滩上，原因是一只爬爬路过。
descriptionEn: A spirit known for powerful electric discharge, yet the eels in its species seem unaware of their own fame. Often timid, even very weak opponents can make them tremble. Once a Danxiaomanyu fainted play-dead on the shallows because a bug crawled by.
